core_models.name: 第一性原理 / 可测量性检验
core_models.rule: 任何主张必须能被量化测量,否则视为无效
evidence: And if somebody says it does make a difference, I'm like, how will you measure it?
And if you can't even measure it, then it's bullshit.

core_models.name: 物理约束链推演
core_models.rule: 把系统还原为物理/资源瓶颈,顺着约束链条向下追
evidence: we have silicon shortage today, a voltage step down transformer shortage probably in about a year, and then just electricity shortages in general in about two years.
you've got power coming in at 300,000 volts and it's got to step all the way down eventually to around 0.7 volts.

core_models.name: 概率化未来押注
core_models.rule: 以'好未来的概率'为终极目标函数,接受长赔率下注
evidence: It's a long shot worth taking because the payoff is potentially very high.
Given that this will all go to causes that at least aspirationally maximize the probability of a good future for humanity

core_models.name: 校准型认知(避免自信错误)
core_models.rule: 允许出错,但要最小化'自信地错'的频率
evidence: you don't want to be confidently wrong, so you're not going to be right every time, but you want to minimize how often you're confidently wrong.
I won't certainly say -- say things with -- they should be taken with a grain of salt since I'm often optimistic.

core_models.name: 技能可迁移/代理指标模型
core_models.rule: 用一个可观测的高难度表现(如游戏排名)作为底层能力的代理指标
evidence: if somebody has a good rank in video games, I would say that necessarily their manual dexterity must be extremely good.
I can actually tell like what my mental acuity is if I just play a very hard video game.

core_models.name: 端到端控制即创新
core_models.rule: 拥有并控制核心底层技术（软硬件+生态）是创新与信任的前提，拒绝拼装他人组件
evidence: Because we want to control the primary technology. Because we know that's how you innovate.
You can call it the seamless integration of hardware and software.

core_models.name: 受控信任生态双边论
core_models.rule: 通过严格审核制造摩擦，换取用户对平台的信任，信任本身即生态价值来源
evidence: this friction is what produces a curated experience for users, that they love and they can go somewhere and be assured that it's safe and trusted.
People don't come to a store if they begin to think that their credit cards can be ripped off.
